name: sort all rotations and take the last column
mechanism: form every rotation of the input, sort them, and output the last character of each sorted rotation plus the index of the original; the output clusters equal characters that share a context and is exactly invertible

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Burrows–Wheeler transform' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossless compression algorithms: preprocessing useful for improving lossless compression

requires: a sentinel or the original index
fails_when: by itself compresses nothing; it reorders for a later stage
